test2: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'pot1': '1', 'pot2': '0', 'pot3': '0', 'rgb1': 'red:1, green:0, blue:0', 'rgb2': 'red:1, green:0, blue:0', 'sevseg1': '9', 'sevseg2': '0'}, 'description': 'Potentiometer 1 moved to maximum (1), controlling red component. test3: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'pot1': '1', 'pot2': '1', 'pot3': '0', 'rgb1': 'red:1, green:1, blue:0', 'rgb2': 'red:1, green:1, blue:0', 'sevseg1': '9', 'sevseg2': '0'}, 'description': 'Potentiometer 2 moved to maximum (1), controlling green component. Both RGB LEDs show yellow (red:1, green:1, blue:0). 7-segment display 1 shows 9 (red value remains 9), display 2 shows 0 (blue value remains 0).'}

test4: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'pot1': '1', 'pot2': '1', 'pot3': '1', 'rgb1': 'red:1, green:1, blue:1', 'rgb2': 'red:1, green:1, blue:1', 'sevseg1': '9', 'sevseg2': '9'}, 'description': 'Potentiometer 3 moved to maximum (1), controlling blue component.
